title: Technology Sector Update for 02/04/2019: ULTI, ON, NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.02%
AAPL: +0.19%
IBM: +0.14%
CSCO: -0.36%
GOOG: +0.29%
Technology stocks were mixed in Monday's pre-bell trade.
Early movers include:
(+) Ultimate Software Group ( ULTI ), which was surging more than 19% after it agreed to be acquired by a group led by private equity firm Hellman & Friedman for $11 billion in cash, or $331.50 per share.
(+) ON Semiconductor ( ON ) was climbing more than 3% on the back of better-than-expected earnings for Q4 while providing guidance for Q1.
In other sector news:
(+) Nvidia ( NVDA ) was trading higher after it received notice of an unsolicited "mini-tender" offer by private investor TRC Capital Corp. to purchase up to 1 million shares of its common stock at a price of $149.88 per share in cash.
